propositions: Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests exist only in the process-local asyncio queue; if the process exits before the forced event is dequeued, the request is lost and reconciliation skips the revision because Gerrit still carries the old nonzero vote and the matched local voted row prevents re-review.

The durable repair resets the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review: 0 before acknowledging acceptance; the resulting Gerrit comment-added event carrying patchSet.revision and patchSet.ref becomes the durable marker that re-admits the change to reconciliation after process loss.

Reconciliation must query Gerrit before consulting local dedup; a successful no-nonzero-vote read clears only the exact stale voted row and proceeds to review, while a Gerrit read error preserves dedup and holds the cursor back for retry.

Contributor text in recheck or rerun requests cannot select a label value or mint PASS/BLOCK; only the bot's privileged reset operation writes the fixed neutral 0 value, and affirmative/refusal replies remain label-free.

The reset operation must verify that no nonzero LLM-Review vote remains across all accounts after the reset write; a surviving concurrent or admin vote is fail-closed and rejects the request as RETRIGGER_REFUSED without emitting a forced event.
